review_text: Amazing. Im really impressed by how useful the signs by the bones and old extinct dinasaures and mammales are. Glass flower exhibit made only for harvard in 1904-1914, one of a kind, still on display. great taxidermy animals (mammals and fish and birds)!! Really good (ok collection is like 100+ years old and animals really jammed together. Some have better personalities and internal structure than others, but sheer volumn and the placement of bone skeletons next to taxidermy skins is great for comparson). Rock and gem area is fabulous. Not small rocks. It's almost overwhelming to see so many together, and grouped into rock families.  I like the exhibits, but i rate this museum high because the signage was inciteful, readable and explained how items were grouped. There were kids groups going through scavenging hunting for answers.  And workers around to answer exhibit questions. Reasonble price, and can see a few other nearby museums. I was there on a weekday

review_text: Caspar, the shelter at 240 albany, feeds people donuts for breakfast and low quality, nutrient poor foods. They have a nice restaurant grade kitchen, too. Also, they refused my donation of two loaves of bread, two cartons of eggs, and three cartons of strawberries purchased via food stamps. I don't necessarily disagree with their decision to refuse the food, but there is CLEARLY some abuse of power happening here. People, please investigate this situation and take action so that the people living in the shelter can eat healthily. Share it on social media. Also, build a 5 star hotel resort for the homeless, and rezone the golf course.

review_text: Love visiting state park with my coworkers to unwind. Tried their root beer float, and loved it. Big portion! Their patio is nice, although we did get into a predicament with the staff. We were celebrating a coworkers departure, most of us got drinks and finger foods but they didn’t want all of us to sit on the patio. And then later that evening after spending most of the night inside the bar, I asked the patio staff for 4 of us to eat on the patio, where he said yes, but then when I went to collect the rest of the group in the bar, the bar staff told me we were not allowed to go up to the patio. So then I had to wait while those two connected on the issue. We then ate up there, no problem. Anyway, didn’t enjoy the tension.

review_text:
This place is exactly what you want out of a dive. Good vibe, warm atmosphere, no frills, and surprisingly good food. Food punches well above its weight for a place like this. Beer list is pleasant, with several options (national, local, and import).

Duck nachos are awesome because each chip is loaded so your bite is perfect. The kale Cesar is surprisingly good (I’m not a salad guy). Wings looked better than they tasted and were admittedly average (think they could have used a few more min in the fryer), as was the sandwich, but overall I was pleased with everything we got.
